steps.title: Install the Blender add-on
steps.detail: Unify finds Blender, installs the DSH Bridge add-on and turns it on. If Blender isn't found, install it by hand: Edit > Preferences > Add-ons > the menu at the top right > Install from Disk..., pick the file below, then tick DSH Bridge.

steps.title: Restart Blender
steps.detail: Close and reopen any Blender windows. They connect to Unify by themselves once the add-on is on.
